title: Conbunn Cardboard
description:
CARDBOARD WALK!A relaxed platformer to hop around while collecting the lost CDs of Connie, a well-known DJ. Help the bunny to recover them while exploring cardboard and paper environments.

No need to hurry though, take your time and enjoy the island as you prefear!

FEATURES• Explore areas like Paint Hills, Cutout Forest or Paper Bay, among others!
• Unlock skins for the bun with your progress!
• 40 CDs to collect with unique illustrations!
• Several Sub-Areas with minigames and platforming challenges!
• Cute Bunns!

BUN BUN CONBUNN!Connie is a well-known DJ in Cardbun Island. Her artistic name is Conbunn! Her friend Cell is a bird, and she has lost the "Conbunn Discs" (CDs) that Connie needed before a concert. Collect a good amount of them and reach the top to perform that night session!
description_short: A chill and cozy platformer. Hop around collecting the lost CDs of a cute DJ in this land made of cardboard!
